rows.grounds: compound of tat + karṇikā + saṃstha; adjective describing residence in the pericarp
compound of śiva + sāyujya; object of attainment

items.question: What attainment results from being situated in the pericarp of that lotus?
items.inference: Therefore residence in that pericarp brings union with Shiva.
uncertainties: Final visarga is absent in the supplied token.
items.plain_english: Situated in the pericarp of that lotus, one attains union with Shiva.
